# Problem Definition Worksheet

**EDD SOP — Phase 1: Problem Definition**

The starting point for every EDD project. Your supervisor must sign this document before development begins.

## Problem Statement

> Describe the problem in 2–3 sentences. Focus on the workflow gap, inefficiency, or unmet need. State what currently happens, why it is a problem, and who is affected.

_Write here._

## Success Criteria

> At least three measurable criteria. "Measurable" means a number, a time, a count, or a yes/no — not "easier" or "better."

## Required Functions

> List every function the tool must perform. Mark each as **Must** (tool is broken without it), **Should** (significantly less useful without it), or **Nice** (would be nice to have).

| # | Function Description | Priority |
|---|----------------------|----------|
| 1 |                      | Must     |
| 2 |                      | Must     |
| 3 |                      | Should   |
| 4 |                      | Nice     |

| Field                     | Value / Notes |

| Data sensitivity tier     | Public / Internal / CUI / Restricted |
| Approved platform         | GenAI.mil / CamoGPT / Power Platform / other (specify) |
